verses.en: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.sm: Atua i e o agaleaga i ona tagata Faauta mai, o ia ona aso ma lea tausaga, pe a ou faafoisia le tafeaga o Iuta ma Ierusalema,

verses.en: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.sm: ou te faapotopotoina ai nuu uma lava, ou tè aveina ifo i latou i le vanu o Iosefatu, ou te faasalaina ai i latou ona o loʻu nuu, ma loʻu tofi o Isaraelu o e na faataapeapeina e i latou i nuu ese, o loʻu fanua foi na latou tofitofia.

verses.en: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai le vili e maua ai loʻu nuu; ua latou tuuina atu se tama e fai ma tau o se fafine talitane, ua avatu foi se teine ma tau o uaina latou te feinu ai.

verses.en: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.sm: Turo e, ma Saitonu, ma le itu uma o Filisitia e, se a la outou na ia te au? tou te au mai ea se taui ia te au? afaj. tou te taui mai ia te au, ou te taalise ona faafoi faafuasei lo outou taui i o outou ulu.

verses.en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
verses.sm: Aua ua outou avea laʻu ario ma laʻu auro, o a'u mea lelei ma le aoga tele ua avatu ai i o outou malumalu;

verses.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
verses.sm: o le fanau a Iuta ma le fanau a Ierusalema ua outou faatauina i le fanau a lavana, ina ia outou ave mamao ia te i latou io latou nuu.

verses.en: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.sm: Faauta mai, ou te lagaina i latou ai le mea ua outou faatauina atu i ai i latou, ou te faafoisia foi lo outou taui i o outou щy.

verses.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.sm: Ou te faatau atu o outou atalii ma o outou afafine i le pule a le fanauga a Iuta, latou te faatau atu foi ia te i latou i Sepea, o le nuu mamao; aua ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.sm: Ia outou tala‘iina atu lenei mea i nuu ese, ia outou sauniuni le taua, ia outou lagaina tagata totoa, ia faalatalata mai, ma o ae o tagata tau uma lava.

verses.en: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.sm: Ia outou tu‘itu‘i le uamea o outou suotosina e fai ma pelu, ma a outou polo teu vine e fai ma tao; ia faapea mai le ua vaivai, Ua malosi au.

verses.en: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
verses.sm: Outou nuu uma e, ia outou faapotopoto, ma soloai mai, ia outou faapotopoto foi ai itu uma; le ALII e, ia E faaoo ifo i lea mea au ‘au malolosi.

verses.en: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.sm: la laga mai O nuu ese, ma o ae i le vanu o Iosefatu; aua ou te nofo ai e faamasino i nuu uma mai itu uma.

verses.en: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.sm: la outou tuu atu le selesaito, aua ua afu saito; o mai ia, ina outou o ifo; aua ua tumu le mea e soli ai vine, ua taumasuasua O latou tuugáuaina; auá ua tele lo latou leaga.

verses.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.sm: E toatele lava tagata i le yanu e faasalaina ai, aua ua latalata mai le aso o le ALII i le vanu e faasalaina ai.

verses.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.sm: E faapouliuligia le la ma le masina, o fetu foi e le toe fepulafi mai.

verses.en: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: E faataio foi le ALII mai Siona, e túlei izo lona siufofoga ai Ierusalema; e luluina le lagi ma le lalolagi, a o le ALII, o le malu o 1a o lona nun, ma le “olo o le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.sm: Tou te iloa foi o au o le ALII lo outou Atua, o le nofo i Siona loʻu mauga paia; ona paia lea o Ierusalema, o tagata ese foi latou te le toe ui atu ai lava.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.sm: A oo foi i lea aso, ona tautulu mai lea o suávine i mauga, e tafe foi le suāsusu i mauga iti, o alia uma foi o Iuta e tafe mai ai suāvai; e tafe mai se punavai ai le fale o le ALII, e faasùsù ai le vanu o Setima.

verses.en: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.sm: E faatafunaina Aikupito, e avea Etoma ma laueleele gaogao, ona o le faasaua i le fanauga a Iuta, auā ua latou faamaligiina i lo latou nuu le toto o e le sala.

verses.en: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.sm: A e tumau Iuta e faavavau, o Ierusalema foi i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga.

verses.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
verses.sm: Ou te faamamā lo latou toto sa le faamamāina e aʻu; o aʻu lava o le ALII o lē nofo i Siona.
